# SumDOS2

Module: **QuantumDots** · directory: `QuantumDots/src/Analysis` · binary: `QuantumDots/src/Tools/Analysis/SumDOS2`

```text
SumDOS2, version 0.01

Usage: SumDOS2 [options] 

Options:

input options:
    -d, --directory : pattern to identify directories that contain states description (if pattern is mydir/run, any directory in mydir such that runx where x is an integer will be considered)
    --input : beginning of the name of file describing states (without relative/absolute path, files has to be of the form NAMEraw where x is an integer
    --begin : number of the first directory (default value = 0)
    --end : number of the last directory (0 if it has to be detected automatically) (default value = 0)
    -n, --nbr-state : number of initial states (0 if it has to be detected automatically) (default value = 0)

plot options:
    --min : lower limit of the spectrum (in meV unit) (default value = 0)
    --max : upper limit of the spectrum (in meV unit) (default value = 0)
    -t, --temperature : temperature (in Kelvin unit) (default value = 10)
    -g, --gamma : full width at half maximum of each Lorentzian peak (in meV unit) (default value = 0.01)
    --step : length of each discretized step (in meV unit) in the spectrum (default value = 0.00020000000000000001)
    --output : name of the output file

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help
    -v, --verbose : verbose mode

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
